title: tc-team-roster
description:
A team directory with everyone's local time – status, role and team, how far ahead or behind you they are, whether
they're working, skills – grouped and filtered, as a list or a grid, with the team's best hour to meet.

heading.description: The heading, and the roster's name

now.description: The time now, epoch ms; by default the element's own clock, read every minute

viewerTimezone.description: "Your time": the viewer's IANA time zone; by default the browser's

groupBy.description: How members are grouped. Changed by the user unless a tc-group-change listener calls preventDefault()

filter.description: What the filter box holds. Changed by the user unless tc-filter-change is prevented

view.description: A list or a grid of cards. Changed by the user unless tc-view-change is prevented

selected.description: The selected member's id. Changed by the user unless tc-selected-change is prevented

locale.description: The language for times, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

avatar.description: A picture URL; without one the member shows their initials

workingHours.description: Their working day in their own time, "09:00" to "17:30"; 09:00–17:30 when they have a time zone but no hours
